page.layout: One text column, full width, with small marginal notes down the right margin. Below the column, at the right edge, are a few further marginal fragments. Printed page 11 with running head at top.

main_text.p: patritii, utilitate agricolæ, numero ac robore opifices præstarent. Patritiis verò quibus maximè conciliatis habebat opus, & amplissimis promissis sefe obligaverat, hoc præcipuum tribuit, si Plutarcho credimus, ut hi soli, id quod regum esse solet, sacra curarent, magistratus & dignitates caperent, leges interpretarentur, in iis, quæ ad religionem & religiosa pertinebant, quid fas esset, dijudicarent. Vtrum autem ex hac Thesei constitutione, iidem quoque jus acceperint, designandi eos ex classe suâ, qui magistratus gererent, an classibus cæteris hoc tributum fit, ut in communionem suffragiorum cum iis venirent, id ex verbis Plutarchi, ex quo hæc de Theseo habemus, non liquet. Verba ejus hoc tantum significant, tributum[illegible, ~3 letters] esse à rege patritiis, dare magistratus [illegible, ~3 letters] παρέχειν ἀρχὰς[?]. Quemadmodum ca[?]tera[illegible, ~4 letters] quoque de magistratibus iisdem[?] ignota nobis manent, cujusmodi ii fuerint, quis eorum ordo, quæ potestas[illegible, ~3 letters] munus, & quanti temporis, aliaque his similia. Quòd si tamen conjecturæ locus, verisimile puto, suffragium classium inferiorum, aut simul omnium ex classe summâ magistratus esse certos. Nam si secus res habuisset, quod dò dici ab Isocrate potuisset, quod ap[illegible, ~3 letters]

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are small, overlapping and partly cut by the scan edge; their letters could not be read reliably and are marked illegible. The Greek on the line "παρέχειν ἀρχὰς" is doubtful (the scan is faint there). "ca[?]tera" is partly hidden by a marginal note; the printed word is probably "cætera". The word "iisdem" is doubtful. The last line is cut off at the lower edge of the scan, so "quod ap" may continue with text not visible on the scan. The bottom-right fragment "ds ab:ds" is a marginal reference mark and is doubtful.
